description.value:
Duration constant

You gain resistance to bludgeoning damage equal to half your level, and you are not off-guard while prone.

cinderfall.incomplete: The half-level bludgeoning Resistance is built above -- both the Resistance key/value shape (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/dwarf/level-5/blast-resistance.json) and the exact floor(@actor.level/2) formula string (confirmed live in multiple real cards, e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/ancestry-features/undead/advanced-undead-benefits.json) are independently verified real. "Not off-guard while prone" is not built: no real feat suppressing the inherent prone-grants-off-guard rule was found, though this specific absence was searched less exhaustively than others in this pass -- treated as the weaker of the two claims.
